planets.name: TOI-244 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-244 with a 7.4-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-244 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-244. Its orbit and size follow Castro-González et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
